behaviors.description: filesize.naturalsize formats byte counts as strings using decimal suffixes by default; naturalsize(3000000) returns '3.0 MB'.
With binary=True, filesize.naturalsize uses base 1024 and binary suffixes; naturalsize(3000, binary=True) returns '2.9 KiB'.
With gnu=True, filesize.naturalsize uses base 1024 and GNU prefixes, ignoring binary; naturalsize(3000, gnu=True) returns '2.9K'.
The format option controls numeric formatting; naturalsize(3000, gnu=True, format='%.3f') returns '2.930K'.
Negative byte counts retain their sign; naturalsize(-4096, binary=True) returns '-4.0 KiB'.
